Rails passes `create(tz_id, nil, TZInfo::Timezone.get(tz_id))` (time_zone.rb:278) because `create` is `alias_method :create, :new` over `initialize(name, utc_offset = nil, tzinfo = nil)`. trails resolves zones through `Intl`, which has no TZInfo::Timezone object to hand over, so `create` takes the name alone and looks the zone data up itself; the third argument has no value to carry. Converges when trails grows a tzinfo object (the `time-with-zone-residue-structural-blockers` seam).
